summary: Yeosu Airport serves the scenic coastal city of Yeosu on South Korea's southern Jeollanam-do coast, a region celebrated for its beautiful islands, seafood, and maritime heritage. The facility gained increased prominence when it supported the 2012 Yeosu World Expo and continues to serve as a key gateway to one of Korea's most picturesque waterfront destinations. The airport handles a mix of domestic routes and select regional services, making it an essential link for tourism in Korea's southwest.
